bracket_math: agent_s_low = to.low - from.high; agent_s_high = to.high - from.low (clamped at 0). ratio_low = agent_s_low / pro_s; ratio_high = agent_s_high / pro_s.

verdict.rule: run_median = median over segments of (ratio_low + ratio_high) / 2. FLAG if ratio_low > flag_k_times_median * max(run_median, 1) AND agent_s_low - pro_s >= flag_min_excess_s. Otherwise SLOW if ratio_low > ok_max_ratio, else OK. Always report the raw ratios.
verdict.why: A uniformly slower player (slower hands, model latency) should come out SLOW everywhere, not FLAG everywhere. FLAG marks segments that lose time out of proportion to the run's own pace: that is where a missed technique or a detour shows up. The 5 s floor stops tiny segments (2.45 s) from flagging on noise. 1.25 allows for run-to-run variance between pros on the same seed (the two verified pro runs on this seed differ by 1.56x in total IGT: 169.149 / 108.421).

waste_rules.when: facts.overworld_arrival_xyz is more than 8 blocks (3D) from facts.end_portal_xyz
waste_rules.seconds: agent_s_low - pro_s (upper bound: includes execution time)
waste_rules.why: The Nether exit position sets where the overworld portal appears (within 16 blocks horizontally of 8x the Nether position, closest valid spot). Building at (end_portal.x/8, end_portal.z/8) lands next to the portal; the pro's 2.45 s segment shows it is done in practice.

waste_rules.when: (facts.beds_collected - facts.beds_used) > (pro.beds_collected - pro.beds_used); pro values from the playbook, default 0 leftover if unknown
waste_rules.why: Beds not used on the dragon are pure collection time.

waste_rules.seconds: facts.model_latency_s (reported on its own line, never subtracted from the verdict)
waste_rules.why: The agent's clock includes model thinking time; report it, do not hide it.
Route tortuosity; needs path data, not available from the montage.
From the agent's event log; not visible in the montage.

waste_rules.seconds: time of the death and recovery
waste_rules.why: A death ends a real speedrun.

waste_rules.when: manual: an action done before its prerequisite forced a return trip

fairness.difficulty: Agent on Peaceful, pros on Easy. Peaceful only helps the agent (no hostile mobs, no hunger). Not adjusted; noted.
fairness.timer: Agent banner = wall-clock elapsed time of the run, including model latency. Pro primary times are IGT. Report the agent against both pro IGT and pro RTA (1:48 run: IGT 108.421, RTA 119.331). Segment times for pros are IGT unless the timing sheet says otherwise.
fairness.practice: Pros practise a set seed many times; the agent run is the author's best published run, also after many development runs (rmalde/minecraft-agent:optimization/COMPARISON.md, NOTES.md). Neither is a first attempt.
fairness.brackets: The montage has cuts, so every agent milestone is a [low, high] bracket. Verdicts use the side that is most favourable to the agent (ratio_low).
fairness.route_supplied: The agent's route, including the exit-portal coordinates, is fixed in its config (rmalde/minecraft-agent:README.md:104). A missed shortcut in that route is a miss of the agent system as published, not of the LLM alone.
fairness.rng: Dragon perch timing is partly random (rmalde/minecraft-agent:README.md:7, 'Dragon flight and landing times can vary'). The End segment is reported, but its FLAG/SLOW verdict should be read with that in mind.
